title: Encoded cell bit retrieval
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input symbols, and let $cv$ be a cell value for $N$. For every natural number $t$ with $t<W(N)$, the bit at position $t$ of the length-$W(N)$ encoding of $cv$, using 	ext{false} as the default for an out-of-range list lookup, equals the bit specified by the chunk-bit rule at position $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input symbols
